scope: Public evidence for a fictional Indonesia upstream demonstration; no real well observations.

publicGeology.title: Petani horizontal well management strategy - Menggala Formation
publicGeology.evidence: Public abstract reports two horizontal completions at 3920 ft TVD, approximately 1195 m TVD.
publicGeology.limit: Historical case-specific anchor; vertical datum unspecified. Not TVDSS or a present-day well dataset.

publicGeology.title: Central Sumatra fluid barriers and wireline formation pressures
publicGeology.evidence: Different regional and local depletion behavior supports investigating, rather than assuming, connectivity.
publicGeology.limit: Reported depletion magnitudes are not uniform basin-wide inputs to the synthetic generator.

publicGeology.title: Marginal Minas X-sand productivity enhancement
publicGeology.evidence: Case describes approximately 20% porosity, permeability below 15 mD, 20 ft thickness and low resistivity.
publicGeology.limit: Reported oil improvement is incremental after treatment, not baseline production or a promised workover outcome.

publicGeology.title: Gelam reservoir engineering compartmentalization study
publicGeology.evidence: Talang Akar retrograde gas-condensate interpretation changed as pressure, PVT and production evidence developed.
publicGeology.limit: Analogue for conflicting interpretations; no assertion that synthetic Rimba measurements belong to Gelam.

publicGeology.title: Talang Akar low-resistivity evaluation, SCOG 45(3), 169-181
publicGeology.evidence: Study-specific screening includes porosity >14%, permeability >10 mD, Vsh <30%, Sw <70%; saline water contributes to low resistivity.
publicGeology.limit: Not universal cutoffs; Sw is not produced water cut. Journal metadata dates are inconsistent; cited by volume year.

publicGeology.title: Upper Cibulakan seismic amplitude analysis - LES-1
publicGeology.evidence: Main/Massive marine sandstones at 800-2000 m subsea; reported gas and condensate rates combine five tested zones.
publicGeology.limit: Combined multi-zone test rates are not daily field production. No actual seismic was obtained for this demo.

publicGeology.title: Upper Cibulakan Main interval sequence stratigraphy - U-11
publicGeology.evidence: Sandstone packages approximately 50-100 ft thick, separated by shale sections up to 250 ft.
publicGeology.limit: Gross package thickness is not net pay or hydrocarbon volume.

architecture.finding: Public personal MIT walkthrough combines ADME/OSDU-shaped Fabric data with SharePoint evidence using Copilot Studio. It is not an implemented Foundry IQ/3D viewer application.
Documented preview ACZ path exports Delta data to ADLS Gen2 and uses OneLake shortcuts. Do not call a synthetic load live ADME mirroring or automatic OSDU ACL propagation.
Current REST article documents semanticEnrichment, while older JSON schemas do not fully describe it. Entity synonyms; property/relationship descriptions and attributes.

Metadata aids contextual understanding but is not directly consumed by ontology query generation; public Data Agent does not currently use relationship enrichment. Keep critical units/grain rules in source instructions.
Use managed Lakehouse tables with supported primitive types. A dated fact can be a NonTimeSeries entity, making its full history available to GQL.
Early filters, explicit labels, bounded traversals and scalar projections. Preserve fact grain independently of query speed.
Graph ingestion/refresh is separate from source writes. REST-created Graph requires first portal initialization; source freshness is not automatically graph freshness.
Ontology source does not support source-specific instructions/example queries. Use agent-level instructions; do not invent an ontology datasource REST shape from the graph datasource schema.
Educational Lamna model is an example, not a domain ontology. The user's deployed Lamna is larger and contains a sixth derived monitoring-signals entity.

syntheticBoundary: All field names, well identifiers, trajectories, measurements, volumes, events and authored reports are fictional. Public geological anchors do not establish statistically validated basin-wide engineering distributions.
